body.statement: Using \(\mathsf{CensusHandle}\), complete the characteristic-zero, per-orbit coordinate census for rooted graph-query isomorphism orbits in \(\mathcal G_{n,k}\) with \(n\leq5\) and \(k\leq2\).  Treat the certified five-node cubic coordinate case and \(\mathrm{lem:five\mbox{-}node\mbox{-}quartic\mbox{-}witness}\) as fixed base cases.  For every remaining orbit and original directed-edge query, provide either a covariance-saturated rational univariate representation of its finite queried-coordinate projection in \(A_K=S_G^{-1}(R_{\mathrm{inc}}/I_G)\), or a certificate that \(\lambda_e\) is transcendental over \(K_G\), and compare each finite \(d_e(G)\) with its prescribed-orientation coefficient.  This is a secondary exhaustive certificate and regression-suite question: it no longer asks the census to establish the \(n\leq5\) maximum frontier or to determine the recurrence in the unresolved larger-size region.
body.justification: This is the bounded destructive test that can invalidate the uncorrected orientation-realization conjecture before the all-size proof is attempted.
body.gap: The five-node computations of Foygel, Draisma, and Drton classify whole graphs and selected whole-fiber degrees, not every original-edge coordinate degree under the rooted excess-arrow budget in the \(S_G\)-localized prime incidence algebra.
body.consumer: The frontier proof receives certified base cases or a concrete correction term, and fasttreeid receives a complete small-instance regression suite.

obligation.what_is_open: The exhaustive characteristic-zero coordinate census for the remaining rooted graph-query orbits on at most five vertices with excess-arrow budget at most two.
obligation.obstruction: The supplied computation did not enumerate all mixed-graph bidirected supports and original-edge queries modulo rooted isomorphism, and no saturated rational-univariate or transcendence certificate is available for every remaining orbit.
obligation.attempted: I promoted the supplied modular quartic to an exact characteristic-zero proof, verified reducedness and four persistent branches, and matched the queried-coordinate degree to the explicit multihomogeneous coefficient.  Exhaustive orbit generation and certification remain undone.
obligation.partial_result:
The exact rational calculation in \(\mathrm{lem:five\mbox{-}node\mbox{-}quartic\mbox{-}witness}\) proves that the graph with
\[
D=\{0\to1,0\to2,1\to3,2\to3,1\to4,2\to4\},
\qquad B=\{0\leftrightarrow i:1\leq i\leq4\},
\]
and query \(2\to4\) has \(d_{2\to4}(G)=4\) over characteristic zero.  Its specialized residual ideal is reduced, its four queried values are distinct and real, and each has a real positive-definite extension.  Together with the separately transferred cubic base case, this removes both fixed base cases from the remaining census; the other mixed-graph supports and queries have not yet been exhaustively certified.
